headline: Post-midterm session with the 10-year near 4.95%, oil falling on Iran diplomacy hopes, and Friday's payrolls the next big test.
rates: The 10-year Treasury yield closed near 4.95% Tuesday (above 5% as recently as Oct 28) as markets price rising odds of a Fed hike rather than cuts.
fed: No FOMC decision in November (next is Dec 9); the Oct meeting minutes come Nov 18, and Cleveland Fed's Hammack is among the Fed voices traders are watching.
oil: Oil dropped sharply (WTI roughly $97-100, Brent about $110) on hopes the US seeks a diplomatic solution to the Iran war after the midterms, though prices remain elevated.
geo: The US-Iran war and high fuel prices remain the active shock; Democrats' midterm gains raise talk of Congress limiting the war.
